articles.title: Brida
articles.description: A young Irish woman named Brida explores magic and spirituality

articles.title: A Tale of Two Cities
articles.description: Charles Dickens’s great historical novel, set against the violent upheaval of the French Revolution.

articles.title: The Little Prince
articles.description: A pilot forced to land in the Sahara meets a little prince. The wise and enchanting stories the prince tells of his own planet with its three volcanoes and a haughty flower are unforgettable.

articles.title: The Alchemist
articles.description: Paulo Coelho's masterpiece tells the mystical story of Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy who yearns to travel in search of a worldly treasure.
The year 1984 has come and gone, but George Orwell's prophetic, nightmarish vision in 1949 of the world we were becoming is timelier than ever.
